Here are three sentences with 15 characters each, incrementally indented:

    The view was breathtakingly beautiful.
    The view was breathtakingly beautiful.
    The view was breathtakingly beautiful.

And here's a screenplay comparing the sky after a grueling hike and the sky outside a rundown gas station:

FADE IN:

EXT. SUMMIT - DAY

We see JEN (30s), a determined hiker, standing at the summit, arms raised in triumph. The sky is a brilliant blue, with not a cloud in sight.

CUT TO:

EXT. GAS STATION - DAY

We see JEN, now dressed in a stained "I'm with Stupid" t-shirt, standing outside a rundown gas station, arms raised in defeat. The sky is a dull grey, with a haze of exhaust fumes hanging over the desolate landscape.

JEN (V.O)
I thought the summit was the hardest part. But nothing compares to the view from the top of this dump.

CUT TO:

EXT. GAS STATION - DAY

Jen looks out at the bleak landscape, shaking her head.

JEN (V.O)
The sky is a deep shade of despair, a reflection of my soul.

CUT TO:

EXT. SUMMIT - DAY

Jen looks out at the breathtaking view, a smile spreading across her face.

JEN (V.O)
But at least the view from the top of this mountain is worth the hike.

FADE OUT.
